# FDG9126

> CONSIDER naming protected virtual members that provide extensibility points for nonvirtual members by suffixing the nonvirtual member name with “Core.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.9 Template Method.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

## From the book

```csharp

  ...
  SetBoundsCore (...);
}
protected virtual void SetBoundsCore(...){ ... }
```
